qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Swiss wealth management brand and structured products platform provide local presence, but lack an insurmountable structural edge. Active institutional asset management suffers persistent net outflows (CHF -2.7B to -2.9B annually) under passive fee pressure, eliminating pricing power.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (ROIC < 12% and lack of pricing power, REJECT). Mid-sized Swiss wealth and active asset manager suffering continuous institutional outflows from passive alternatives. High cost-to-income ratio (~74%) and sub-hurdle returns on capital (ROE ~11-12%) fail the proof-of-moat test.
qualitative.evidence: ROE of 11-12% through the cycle with high cost-to-income ratio of ~74%. Institutional asset management experienced persistent net outflows (CHF -2.9B in 2024 and CHF -2.7B in 2025) reflecting fee compression and loss of market share to passive indexing.
